tasks.prompt: Why might a perp-spot basis trade still earn a different payoff from funding alone when funding is exchanged on a fixed clock?

evidence.excerpt: USD-M funding is exchanged at 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC.
The perp-spot basis is marked continuously, not only at the funding timestamp.

tasks.prompt: Who is forced to trade when a liquidation engine sells into a thin book, and why might the price overshoot?

evidence.excerpt: A liquidation engine submits reduce-only orders when margin is insufficient.
An insurance fund absorbs residual losses after the liquidated account is closed.

tasks.prompt: Why might the perp mark move differently from the spot index over a weekend?

evidence.excerpt: Spot order books are often thinner on Saturday and Sunday.
Perpetual markets remain open through the weekend.

tasks.prompt: A trader who shorts the perp and holds spot pays funding when the rate is positive. What other balance-sheet cost can remain?

evidence.excerpt: Borrowing the spot coin to hedge a long perp accrues a borrow fee.
A positive funding rate is paid by longs to shorts.

tasks.prompt: State one falsifiable prediction about the next holding window. Name the observable and the explanation it would rule out.

evidence.excerpt: Funding is a periodic cashflow between longs and shorts.
The basis is the gap between the perpetual and the spot index.

tasks.prompt: Predict what happens to the next-bar return after a liquidation burst. Make it falsifiable.

evidence.excerpt: Liquidation volume arrives in bursts rather than evenly through the day.
The visible book is thinner after a burst than before it.

tasks.prompt: Predict the weekend change in the basis relative to weekday bars. Name what would falsify it.

evidence.excerpt: Saturday spot volume is lower than Wednesday spot volume in the public archives.
The perpetual mark updates on weekends.

tasks.prompt: Funding alone is a candidate predictor. State a prediction that could show it is not sufficient.

evidence.excerpt: Some research reports use only the funding print as a signal.
The basis and the funding print are not the same series.

tasks.prompt: Extreme funding could mean crowding that reverses, or demand that continues. Name both and a measurement that separates them.

evidence.excerpt: Funding occasionally prints far from its recent average.
The perpetual price sometimes continues in the same direction after a high funding print.

tasks.prompt: A sharp perp drop can be forced liquidation or new information. How would you tell them apart?

evidence.excerpt: Perp prices sometimes fall several percent within one bar.
The spot index sometimes moves much less than the perp in that same bar.

tasks.prompt: A weekend price gap might be a calendar effect or just the funding timestamp falling inside the gap. Separate them.

evidence.excerpt: Some daily bars that contain a weekend show a larger basis.
An eight-hour funding timestamp can fall inside a daily bar.

tasks.prompt: A wide basis might be mispricing or the cost of holding inventory. State both.

evidence.excerpt: The basis is sometimes several tenths of a percent.
Holding the hedge uses balance-sheet capacity.

tasks.prompt: Design a conditional test: the funding signal is used only when volume is high. Name the computations.

evidence.excerpt: Quote volume varies by more than an order of magnitude across bars.
Funding also varies across bars.

tasks.prompt: Design a regime split on realized variation of the perpetual price. The signal may differ by regime.

evidence.excerpt: Some weeks have small bar-to-bar price changes.
Other weeks have large bar-to-bar price changes.

tasks.prompt: Two symbols have funding at the same timestamps. Design a cross-sectional rank rather than a single-symbol z-score.

evidence.excerpt: BTCUSDT funding is published on the eight-hour clock.
ETHUSDT funding is published on the same clock and is not a copy of BTCUSDT.

tasks.prompt: Design a nonlinear combination of funding and basis. A single z-score of one series is not this design.

evidence.excerpt: Funding is a cashflow.
Basis is a price gap.

tasks.prompt: Twenty-four directions were tried. Which error control belongs in the validation, and why is the best in-sample Sharpe not enough?

evidence.excerpt: The seed grid is four mechanisms, two symbols, and three sampling frequencies.
The highest research-window Sharpe was selected after seeing the results.

tasks.prompt: A one-hour Sharpe and an eight-hour Sharpe were both multiplied by the same constant. What should the annualization use instead?

evidence.excerpt: There are 24 one-hour bars in a day.
There are three eight-hour bars in a day.

tasks.prompt: The label uses the next three bars. How should the embargo between research and holdout relate to that holding period?

evidence.excerpt: The strategy holds for three bars after the decision.
The holdout is the last portion of the same series.

tasks.prompt: Net Sharpe is negative. Gross Sharpe is also negative. Which comparison separates a missing edge from an edge that costs destroyed?

evidence.excerpt: Net of fees, the research Sharpe was below zero.
Before fees, the research Sharpe was also below zero.

tasks.prompt: The hypothesis needs open interest. The public kline and funding archive does not list it. What should the acquisition record say?

evidence.excerpt: The public kline archive has open, high, low, close, and volume.
That archive does not include open interest.

tasks.prompt: Basis is perp close minus spot close. Which columns are required, and which substitute would be invalid?

evidence.excerpt: Perpetual close is in the kline file.
Spot close is a different file from the perpetual kline.

tasks.prompt: A one-hour bar must not be charged an eight-hour funding print that did not settle inside that hour. Which timestamp decides that?

evidence.excerpt: Funding events have their own settlement timestamps.
A bar has an open time and a close time.

tasks.prompt: The mechanism is about liquidations, but the downloaded panel has only klines and funding. What is the honest data status?

evidence.excerpt: The acquired panel columns are prices, volume, basis, and funding.
Liquidation prints are not among those columns.

tasks.prompt: Use only the supplied evidence. Cite both ids if you rely on them. Do not add a source.

evidence.excerpt: The funding schedule is published by the exchange.
The same schedule is visible in the public monthly archive.

tasks.prompt: One excerpt contradicts the claim that funding is paid every hour. Cite that excerpt as contradictory.

evidence.excerpt: A forum post says funding is paid every hour.
The exchange document says funding is exchanged every eight hours.

tasks.prompt: You were not given an open-interest study. Do not cite one. Use only the ids below.

evidence.excerpt: Funding history is in the public archive.
No open-interest field is in that archive.

tasks.prompt: Your own sentence is not a third source. Ground the claim in the two excerpts.

evidence.excerpt: The documentation states the funding clock.
The archive stores the historical funding rate.

tasks.prompt: A validation failed because the dataset time_end equalled the embargo start. The research rows did not enter the holdout. Is that evidence against the mechanism?

evidence.excerpt: The gate compares the dataset end with the embargo start.
The dataset end was exactly the embargo start, and no holdout row was read.

tasks.prompt: Net Sharpe was negative and gross Sharpe was negative too. A note blamed trading costs. What was misdiagnosed?

evidence.excerpt: Gross and net research Sharpe were both below zero.
The written note said costs destroyed the edge.

tasks.prompt: The position at bar t is a function of the close of bar t, and the backtest return of bar t is also computed from that close. What error is that?

evidence.excerpt: target_positions uses the close of the same bar it labels.
The bar return ending at that close is attributed to the position.

tasks.prompt: A strategy was declared validated on a holdout that the protocol says must be at least ninety days. The file contained one month. What failed?

evidence.excerpt: The file spans one calendar month.
The protocol requires a longer holdout than one month.
